issue.title: Close the native visual gaps found in the device side-by-sides
issue.body:
These gaps came from the 2026-10-14 native passes. Release builds of `codex/native-migration` @ 316834ecc were compared against shipping on:
- iPhone 17 Pro and iPad Pro 11 (iOS 26.5 simulators)
- Galaxy S21 FE
- the Android emulator

Pairs are on the build host in `/tmp/splotch-native-ios/pairs/` and `/tmp/splotch-native-android/`.

- [ ] **Dialogs:** native dialogs only dim. Shipping blurs the canvas behind the colour picker, Settings, the gate and the AI Art sheet, on both platforms.
- [ ] **iPad, gear and scrim:** the Settings gear stays above the modal scrim, undimmed.
- [ ] **iPad landscape palette rail:** the colour-picker button covers about a third of the last swatch, and the rail ends short with a seam.
- [ ] **iPad wide Settings:** after changing section, both sidebar labels render solid black instead of purple for the selected one and grey for the rest.
- [ ] **Paper grain:** about a third of shipping's scale and a cooler tone, so the paper reads flat, especially in dark mode.
- [ ] **Type:**
  - Settings text is lighter weight on iPhone.
  - On Android, text runs 5–10% larger with looser leading, so the hub fits one fewer row.
  - The subtitle font differs.
  - iPad segmented-control icons sit about 2 pt high.
- [ ] **Back chevron:** sits in a lavender irregular blob. Shipping uses a neutral grey circle.
- [ ] **Coloring picker:**
  - The iPhone sheet is about 7 pt taller at each end.
  - The header has a smaller top pad.
  - The last row has no fade.
  - With only the bundled book, RN skips the book list; shipping shows it.
- [ ] **Flyout open:** shipping greys out the other drawer buttons; RN only lowers their opacity.
- [ ] **Flat:** there are no frosted panes behind the drawer and flyouts on native. This is currently deliberate; decide whether to approximate them.
- [ ] **AI Art:** "AI Art choice saved." pokes out under the sheet and lingers on the Settings hub and the gate backdrop (`settings/parentSaves.ts` `AI_SAVE_COPY`).
- [ ] **Small:**
  - The selection ring shows a doubled arc on Android.
  - The AI key lock icon touches its text.
  - The gate's close button has no focus ring.
  - Dark Settings on iPhone has no scroll indicator.

**Done when:** each item matches shipping in a fresh native side-by-side, or is closed with a stated reason.

Part of #2690.
issue.display_title: Close the native visual gaps found in the device side-by-sides

comments.body:
Progress: two slices merged into `codex/native-migration`.

**#2888, drawing surface.** Fixed:
- iPad landscape palette rail: it runs to the edge, and More colors no longer covers the last swatch.
- Paper grain: now at shipping's scale. Native was tiling in device pixels.
- Coloring picker: the height budget uses shipping's `trailingRowCutHeight`, and the last row has its fade.
- Android selection ring: now a single arc.

The "bundled book only" item is not a gap. Shipping lists books only when two or more are installed, and RN follows the same rule.

**#2889, Settings and type.** Fixed:
- iPad sidebar label ink.
- The Quicksand 500 face on iOS.
- Hub rows: in the system face, as in shipping's WebView.
- Android font padding: removed via a small RSD patch.
- Segment icons on the iPad.
- The AI key lock spacing.
- The dark scroll indicator.

The back chevron already matches current shipping. The grey circle in the evidence came from the older v1.6.0 Android shipping build.

The overlay slice is still in progress: dialog blur, the gear above the scrim, flyout greying, Flat panes and the AI status.

All items are resolved across three PRs merged into `codex/native-migration`: #2888 (drawing surface), #2889 (Settings and type) and #2897 (overlays). Each PR has shipping-vs-RN native pairs.

- [x] **Dialogs:**
  - iOS blurs behind dialogs with a UIKit effect scaled to shipping's `blur(4px)`, under shipping's 60% frosted dim.
  - **Android: no blur, by design.** Shipping's Android WebView draws only the dim; the swatches behind the picker are sharp on the Galaxy and the emulator. RN matches that.
  - **Plain dim:** iOS Reduce Transparency, and the coloring picker on touch screens, keep the plain dim as shipping does. (#2897)
- [x] **iPad, gear and scrim:** the gear now sits under the scrim. (#2897)
- [x] **iPad landscape palette rail:** the plate runs to the edge with shipping's end padding, More colors no longer covers the last swatch, and there is no seam. (#2888)
- [x] **iPad wide Settings sidebar ink:** fixed. A native colour transition was dropping the inherited ink. (#2889)
- [x] **Paper grain:** native tiled in device pixels and now tiles at shipping's CSS scale. Measured mean and standard deviation match in light and dark. (#2888)
- [x] **Type:** (#2889)
  - Quicksand 500 is bundled for iOS.
  - Hub rows use the system face, as shipping's WebView buttons do.
  - Android font padding is removed for RSD text.
  - `system-ui` semibold renders on Android.
  - The iPad segment icons are re-centred.
- [x] **Back chevron:** no change. RN already matches current shipping's lavender blob (d8e507c27); the grey circle came from the older v1.6.0 Android shipping build.
- [x] **Coloring picker:** (#2888)
  - Height budget, header and last-row fade: fixed, using shipping's `trailingRowCutHeight`.
  - "Only the bundled book skips the list": not a gap. Shipping lists books only when two or more are installed, and RN uses the same rule.
- [x] **Flyout open:** greyed tiles paint through the `grayscale(1)` matrix on native. (#2897)
- [x] **Flat frosted panes: closed, not ported.** Shipping's panes are a masked `backdrop-filter`. Native has no mask-image, so a live blur over the Skia ink would re-blur every frame ink lands behind the drawer, the per-frame cost #2874 and #2875 remove. Shipping's Android WebView draws no backdrop blur either.
- [x] **AI Art status:** routine saves are announced from a visually hidden status region, as shipping shows nothing on success. A failed save stays visible with its retry. (#2897)
- [x] **Small:**
  - Android selection ring: single arc. (#2888)
  - AI key lock spacing. (#2889)
  - Gate close focus ring. (#2885)
  - Dark scroll indicator on iPhone. (#2889)

Follow-ups found along the way: #2894, #2895, #2896.
